title: GameComponent
description: The Lego connector contract. Every game component brick in this library must validate against this schema so that human or AI builders can discover, understand, and safely wire components together.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier for this component, e.g. 'movement.basic_walk'

version.description: Semantic version of this component definition

platform.description: Which runtimes this component supports or targets

inputs.description: Parameters this component accepts at construction or runtime

outputs.description: Values or state this component exposes for other components to read

events.description: Signals this component emits and/or listens for

dependencies.description: Other component ids required for this component to function

sourceModule.description: Optional pointer to the real implementation this brick was extracted from, e.g. 'roblox-modular-lib/src/PetSystem.lua'
